scope: lot-3 C/N parity projection of the bpmn-io seal (SPEC_PROFILE_CN_PY.md §9.1)
author: spec-seal

comparators.note: canonical byte equality of every expected artifact, DESIGN section 3.1

rerun the operation on the expected payload envelope (complete: mode retained; same activation and placement intent): status ok, identical envelope and placements, zero report entries, baseRevision = revision = the first revision
planRecipe cases with an apply artifact also call applyPlan(plan.payload, envelope.tree, envelope) and compare that PureResult

compileProfile (parity sync PS-25, PS-35): the compile PureResult (one per profile artifact, in order, for a variant list) is compared under profile-c14n/2 after each {"$unsealed": reason} marker is replaced by the actual member at the same position, which must exist (CompiledProfile has no wire shape); the compiled-identity (compiled-identities) artifact is compared under profile-c14n/2 with the compiled section 5.1 identity

notes: pathBase is the repository root; every path in this manifest and in the cases is relative to it.
Each case is the corpus/1 projection of tests/profile_cn/expected/<caseId>.json with identical values; the harness file keeps the derivation.

Case files are profile-c14n/2 bytes (no trailing newline); profile files are the composed variant JSON (2-space indent plus LF); sha256 values are raw file digests (H A6), identity sha256 values are H(profile).
Runtime-specific harness cases (cn-gates-table, cn-c-uncompiled-context) have no projection.

vendored: JS-owned cases imported by the parity sync, committed under vendoredSeal.root as the JS seal publishes them (two carry a parity sync decision, spec section 9.2); they are not projected here; sha256 is the committed file digest.
aliases: byte-identical twins (parity sync PS-37); caseId is the JS case, aliasOf the Python case projected here, sha256 the JS case file digest; no file is copied.
